title: Return named data
summary: NestJS: Return named data. Add an author field.
introduction: Nest sends returned objects as JSON. Open GET /book. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Create a practice project with npx @nestjs/cli new school. Replace src/main.ts with one complete example and run npm run start. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000. The original app files are unused by these small examples.

blocks.title: Return named data

blocks.text: The controller returns an object. Nest serialises title and pages into JSON.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Let Nest write the returned object instead of writing a second response.
